_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): safe minimal markdown renderer — headings, bold/italic, links, lists, inline + fenced code (via comp-code-block). Escaped React nodes, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML for raw text, zero deps. Composes comp-code-block. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-markdown-viewer
description: Safe markdown renderer: headings, bold/italic, links, lists, inline + fenced code blocks. Zero deps, escaped output.
notes: Usage: <MarkdownViewer text={assistantReply} /> — render AI chat answers, docs, READMEs. Fenced code blocks render via comp-code-block (copy + highlighting). Upgrade: swap the body for react-markdown if richer syntax (tables, footnotes) is needed.
